name: Beneath their Names
source:
You are a scholarship student at the secluded Veir Academy. Two heroines. Nora or Lika? Trust or distance? Submit to the system — or break it? An introspective visual novel about tension, closeness, and silent choices. 

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4086490/Beneath_their_Names/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你是偏僻的维尔学院里一名领着奖学金的学生。两个女主角，选诺拉，还是莉卡？是交付信任，还是保持距离？服从制度，还是打破它？这是一部内省的视觉小说，讲述紧张与亲近，以及那些无声的选择。

［摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4086490/Beneath_their_Names/]Steam[/url]］
